correctness.rationale: Two exact multiplier identities prove the periodic weighted-slope law, and generator identities prove its compact-invariant-measure extension. The Goodwin reduction and Hurwitz-threshold factorization were checked symbolically, with a numerical orbit as corroboration.

originality.rationale: Forger's 2011 exact period relation and Chen--Shih's 2026 local Hopf threshold are credited as prior art. No inspected source states the derivative-energy-weighted slope law, its invariant-measure form, or the global slope-crossing consequence. Older Goodwin and third-order-ODE literature remains a material residual coverage risk.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies an exact finite-amplitude continuation of the local third-order Hopf slope threshold and forces every genuinely nonlinear Goodwin periodic orbit to cross that critical-slope surface; the measure formulation covers arbitrary compact recurrent statistics.
